subject: Request: SOC 2 artifacts — MFA/log slices, KMS rotation, bridge letter
messages:
From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@riverside.health>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Evidence request: SOC 2 Type II — token/MFA/access log slices

Jonas,

Following up from our procurement checklist: our auditors asked for a couple of SOC 2 Type II-era artifacts beyond the report itself so we can close our internal security review. Can you provide the following by EOB Tuesday (2027-03-16) if possible?

1) MFA enforcement log slice for 2026-07-01 through 2026-12-31 (per-user enforcement events and timestamps; if exportable as CSV that’s ideal).
2) Proof of key rotation for the KMS master keys that cover 2026-11-01 through 2026-12-31 (rotation manifest, KMS event ids, and any associated DocuSign if applicable).
3) Privileged access review artifacts for Q3/Q4 2026 (review roster, sign-off records).
4) Admin role authz-change log for the audit period (changes to admin/owner roles with timestamps and actor).
5) A short bridge letter confirming scope/audit period coverage and whether any controls changed between the report period and now (we know some customers require it when there’s an audit gap).

Also: are there any retention/PII redaction steps we should be aware of when you send logs? Our team prefers RFC3339 timestamp formats and CSVs where possible. Let me know if you need a narrower time window or we should accept aggregated/hashed identifiers.

Thanks — Sarah

Sarah Jensen
Security Program Manager
Riverside Health
security@riverside.health

---

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. I can get started on this and will loop in Security and Compliance to pull the slices and draft the bridge letter. Two quick clarifying questions before we pull logs:

- Do you need the full user identifiers, or are hashed identifiers acceptable for MFA/event correlation?
- For the KMS rotation artifacts, do you need CloudKey IDs + rotation timestamps, or a signed manifest is sufficient?

We're targeting to share artifacts by EOB 2027-03-15; if anything hits a blocker I’ll surface it immediately. Looping in Laura (Compliance) and Marcus (Platform Security) — Marcus, can you confirm availability to extract the MFA and authz-change slices? Laura, can you own the bridge letter draft and privileged review artifacts?

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
